create_indic_glue_metric: create an IndicGLUE evaluation metric for Indian language NLU benchmarks with accuracy, f1, or precision@10
compute_simple_accuracy: compute simple accuracy by comparing predictions and labels arrays element-wise
compute_acc_and_f1: compute accuracy and f1 score for classification predictions against ground truth labels
compute_precision_at_10: compute precision@10 for sentence embedding retrieval using cosine similarity and mean centering
load_indic_glue_config: load an IndicGLUE metric with a specific config like wnli, copa, wiki-ner, or cvit-mkb-clsr
